---

## 1. Company Background & Manufacturing Infrastructure
Gagan Engineering Works was founded in 2006 in the industrial corridor of Khopoli, Maharashtra (between Mumbai and Pune). The workshop specializes in heavy-duty metal forming machinery, roll forming production lines, hydraulic coil processing equipment, and thermal pressing machinery for intimate apparel.

All fabrication, CNC turning, roller machining (EN31 alloy tool steel), hydraulic power pack assembly, and electrical control panel wiring are executed in-house.

---

## 2. Complete Machinery Catalogue & Technical Specifications

### Category A: Bra Cup Moulding Machines (Intimate Apparel & Lingerie Sector)

#### 1. Double Head Electric Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `double-head-electric-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-BRA-DH`
- **Application**: Continuous simultaneous moulding of seamless bra cups, swimwear cups, and activewear inserts.
- **Drive System**: Twin independent pressing stations with dual pneumatic cylinders (6–8 bar) and electric heating platens.
- **Heating Control**: Dual-Zone Microprocessor Digital PID Temperature Regulators (0°C to 250°C, ±1.5°C stability).
- **Production Output**: 400 to 600 pairs per 8-hour shift.
- **Platens**: High-grade hardened alloy tool steel with mirror polish.
- **Moulds**: Aircraft-grade CNC aluminium interchangeable bullet dies (sizes 28A through 44DD).
- **Power Supply**: 3-Phase 415V AC, 50Hz (customizable for 220V/380V/480V 60Hz grids).
- **Clamping**: Automated pneumatic cylinder with digital dwell timer (5–99s) and dual-hand safety interlock.
- **Compatible Materials**: PU foam sheets, laminated fabric-foam composites, memory foam, spacer fabric, spandex.

#### 2. Bra Cup Fabric Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `bra-cup-fabric-moulding-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-BRA-FAB`
- **Application**: Wrinkle-free moulding of woven fabrics, microfibers, cotton-spandex, knitted lace, and laminated textiles.
- **Moulds**: Precision CNC-machined aerospace-grade aluminium bullet and bowl dies (interchangeable for cup sizes 28A through 44DD).
- **Tensioning System**: Perimeter pneumatic fabric clamp ring ensuring uniform radial stretch and zero wrinkling.
- **Cycle Time**: 20 to 35 seconds per pressing cycle (500–700 pcs / shift).
- **Temperature Range**: Ambient to 240°C with independent top and bottom digital PID thermal zones.
- **Platen Coating**: High-temperature non-stick Teflon coating preventing scorching on white and pastel fabrics.
- **Air Pressure Required**: 5 to 7 bar (kg/cm²).

#### 3. Foam Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `foam-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-BRA-FOAM`
- **Application**: High-density polyurethane foam and memory foam cup formation with permanent molecular shape retention.
- **Heating Mechanism**: Top & bottom heated platens (50°C to 260°C) with ±1.5°C digital microprocessor precision.
- **Thickness Range**: 2 mm to 25 mm PU foam, memory foam, HR foam, and spacer fabrics.
- **Output**: 350 to 500 pieces per 8-hour shift.
- **Clamping Force**: Heavy-duty pneumatic cylinder with guided tie-rods (6–8 bar).

#### 4. Padded Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `padded-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-BRA-PAD`
- **Application**: Multi-layer composite padding fusing outer fabric, PU foam, and inner lining in a single synchronized cycle.
- **Pad Style Support**: Graduated push-up pads, demi cups, balconette, and contour T-shirt bra inserts (sizes 30A through 40D).
- **Heating System**: Independent dual-side PID temperature control (ambient to 260°C).
- **Output**: 300 to 450 pairs per 8-hour shift.
- **Bonding**: Thermal compression fusion eliminating intermediate spray adhesive fumes and layer delamination.

---

### Category B: Roll Forming & Sheet Metal Machinery (PEB & Industrial Roofing)

#### 5. 10 Tons Hydraulic Decoiler
- **Model ID**: `10-tons-hydraulic-decoiler`
- **SKU**: `GSK-DEC-10T`
- **Coil Weight Capacity**: Up to 10,000 kg (10 Metric Tons Continuous Duty).
- **Mandrel Expansion**: Hydraulic wedge-type 4-segment expansion (480 mm to 520 mm standard coil ID) with pilot check valve pressure lock.
- **Main Spindle Shaft**: 220 mm diameter solid forged alloy steel (40Cr) with spherical roller bearings.
- **Coil Width**: Up to 1250 mm / 1500 mm (customizable up to 1600 mm).
- **Drive**: 7.5 HP (5.5 kW) helical geared motor with Variable Frequency Drive (VFD).
- **Braking**: Heavy-duty pneumatic caliper disc brake (6–8 bar) with infrared photoelectric loop control arm.
- **Optional Coil Car**: 10-Ton motorized in-floor hydraulic coil car with rail traversing.

#### 6. Automatic Cut To Length (CTL) Line
- **Model ID**: `automatic-ctl-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-CTL-01`
- **Max Sheet Thickness**: Up to 6.0 mm (Mild Steel / GI) / 4.0 mm (Stainless Steel).
- **Max Strip Width**: 400 mm standard (customizable up to 1500 mm).
- **Line Speed**: 20 meters per minute continuous.
- **Leveler Unit**: 9-roll gear-driven precision leveler (114 mm EN31 alloy steel rolls, hardened to 50–52 HRC and ground).
- **Shearing Unit**: Mechanical/hydraulic guillotine shear with optical rotary encoder measuring bridge (±0.5 mm tolerance).
- **Hydraulics & Tank**: 50 LPM Yuken hydraulic pump with 200-litre reservoir.
- **Automation**: Delta / Siemens PLC with color touchscreen HMI supporting up to 20 batch recipes.
- **Connected Power**: 18 HP total connected electrical load.

#### 7. C & Z Purlin Roll Forming Machine
- **Model ID**: `c-z-purlin-roll-forming-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-PUR-CZ`
- **Application**: Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) structural roof and wall purlins, solar racking.
- **Section Profiles**: C-Purlin (Web 100–300 mm) & Z-Purlin (Web 100–300 mm), Flange 40–80 mm, Lip 10–25 mm.
- **Profile Changeover**: Under 30 minutes via quick-rotate assembly without roll dismounting.
- **Sheet Thickness**: 1.5 mm to 3.0 mm high-tensile Galvanized / HR / CR steel coils.
- **Forming Stations**: 16 to 20 progressive stations with vacuum-hardened Cr12/EN31 tool steel rollers (58–62 HRC) and 75 mm 40Cr shafts.
- **Speed**: 10 to 18 meters per minute with hydraulic flying post-cut shear.
- **Punching**: Multi-station hydraulic hole and slot punching unit for web and flange bolt connections.

#### 8. Corrugated Sheets Making Machine (Tata Nali / GC Sheet Machine)
- **Model ID**: `corrugated-sheets-making-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-CORR-01`
- **Trade Aliases**: Tata Nali Sheet Making Machine, GC Sheet Machine, Galvanized Corrugated Sheet Roll Forming Machine, Liner Roofing Sheet Machine, Nali Patra Machine.
- **Profiles Produced**: Traditional Indian Sinusoidal Round Wave Tata Nali profile (Pitch 76 mm, Wave Depth 18 mm), Galvanized Corrugated (GC) sheet profile, and PEB interior liner roofing sheet profiles.
- **Sheet Thickness**: 0.15 mm to 0.80 mm GI, GP, PPGI, Galvalume & Aluminium coils.
- **Roll Stations**: 16 to 18 progressive forming stages with hardened EN31/Cr12 tool steel rollers (0.05 mm hard chrome mirror plating).
- **Shafts**: Solid 70 mm / 75 mm 40Cr alloy steel shafts with dual heavy-duty bearings.
- **Speed**: 15 to 20 meters per minute with VFD regulation.
- **Drive & Power**: 7.5 HP main geared motor + 5.0 HP hydraulic station with Yuken valves.
- **Cutting**: Hydraulic post-cut guillotine with Cr12MoV vacuum heat-treated shear blade.
- **Control**: Delta / Siemens PLC touchscreen with optical rotary encoder (±1.0 mm accuracy).
- **Output**: 15 to 22 Metric Tons / 8-hour shift (~7,000 to 9,000 meters).

#### 9. Semi-Automatic Pipe Counter Boring and Facing Machine
- **Model ID**: `semi-automatic-pipe-counter-boring-and-facing-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-PCB-60M`
- **Application**: Precision pipe end facing, external weld-prep beveling (30°/37.5°/45°), and internal counter-boring for round pipes and tubes.
- **Max Pipe Capacity**: Up to 60 mm Outside Diameter (OD), wall thickness 0.8 mm to 6.0 mm.
- **Spindle Motor**: 5.0 HP (1450 RPM) with Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) speed control (100–1450 RPM).
- **Clamping**: Rigid self-centering hydraulic V-jaws powered by a 1.0 HP hydraulic power pack (60-litre reservoir).
- **Cycle Time**: 8 to 15 seconds per pipe end (1,500 to 2,400 ends per shift).
- **Tooling**: Standard ISO indexable carbide inserts with quick 60-second indexability.
- **Machining Accuracy**: ±0.05 mm depth and end perpendicularity tolerance.

#### 10. Automatic Roofing Sheet Crimping Machine
- **Model ID**: `automatic-roofing-sheet-crimping-machine`
- **SKU**: `GSK-ROOF-CRM`
- **Application**: Hydraulic curved profile step-crimping for pre-painted galvanized iron (PPGI), GP, and aluminium corrugated/trapezoidal sheets up to 1250 mm wide.
- **Curvature Radius**: Adjustable circular arch from 2.0-meter radius to infinity.
- **Tooling Metallurgy**: Vacuum-hardened Cr12 forged alloy steel dies (58–60 HRC) with polished non-scratch contour.
- **Cycle Speed**: 25 to 35 crimps per minute with automated servo/stepper indexing table.
- **Control**: Delta / Siemens PLC touchscreen with integrated arch radius and rise auto-calculator.
- **Hydraulic Unit**: 5.0 HP Yuken hydraulic station with integrated thermal oil cooling.

## 3. Commercial Terms, Global Export Logistics & Pan-India Service
- **Global Export Logistics**: Proximity to Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT / Nhava Sheva Port, Mumbai) ~65 km from works.
- **Incoterms Supported**: FOB (Nhava Sheva Port), CIF, CFR, EXW (Pan-World Delivery).
- **Voltage Grid Customization**: Configured for 220V, 380V, 415V, 440V, 480V @ 50Hz or 60Hz 3-Phase grids across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
- **Packaging Standards**: Heavy seaworthy anti-corrosion barrier wrapping inside fumigated timber crates.
- **Export Documentation**: Certificate of Origin (COO), Commercial Invoices, Bill of Lading, Packing Lists, CE Compliance Declarations.
- **Delivery Scope**: Pan-India delivery across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi NCR, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and worldwide ocean/air freight.
- **Warranty**: 1-Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty covering all mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic assemblies.
- **After-Sales Support**: Dedicated field service technicians available for on-site commissioning, operator training, remote video support, and lifetime spare parts supply.
